title: Standard Error
overview: Understand how sample size influences uncertainty.
objectives: Relate standard error to sample size.

concepts.name: Standard Error
concepts.definition: Describes the sampling variability of an estimator.

sections.title: SE versus SD
sections.body: SD describes variability in data values; SE describes uncertainty in an estimate such as a sample mean.

activities.title: Compare two studies
activities.prompt: Explain why a study with a larger sample can have a smaller standard error even if individual-level variability is similar.

quiz.question: Which quantity generally decreases as sample size increases?
quiz.rationale: For many estimators, standard error decreases as sample size grows.
